# Fere AI Documentation

> Official docs for Fere AI — autonomous crypto trading agents, Market Pulse, recipes, strategies, Polymarket, Hyperliquid, wallets, credits, and MCP.

Product context for AI crawlers also lives at: https://www.fereai.xyz/llms.txt

## Get Started

- [Welcome](https://docs.fereai.xyz/): AI agents that actually trade — research, reason, and execute across chains.
- [Meet Your AI Agent](https://docs.fereai.xyz/agent): How Fere decomposes requests and acts with a built-in wallet.

## Features

- [Recipes](https://docs.fereai.xyz/recipes): One-click workflows for common trading and research tasks.
- [Strategies](https://docs.fereai.xyz/strategies): Automate instructions on a schedule with memory across runs.
- [Strategy Tools (fere_tools)](https://docs.fereai.xyz/strategy-tools): Sandbox SDK catalog for strategy automation.
- [Hyperliquid](https://docs.fereai.xyz/hyperliquid): Perpetual futures, funding, leverage, and manual chat trading.
- [Cross-Chain](https://docs.fereai.xyz/cross-chain): Gasless bridging and swaps across major chains.

## Developer Tools

- [MCP Support](https://docs.fereai.xyz/mcp): Drive Fere from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP clients.

## Wallet & Rewards

- [Wallet](https://docs.fereai.xyz/wallet): Coinbase CDP security, key export, and non-custodial ownership.
- [Portfolio](https://docs.fereai.xyz/portfolio): Balances, PnL, deposits, and withdrawals across your accounts.
- [Credits](https://docs.fereai.xyz/credits): How agent actions are billed and how to top up.
- [Subscriptions](https://docs.fereai.xyz/subscriptions): Lite, Pro, and Whale monthly credit plans.
- [Refer & Earn](https://docs.fereai.xyz/refer-and-earn): Invite friends and earn credits.
- [Points](https://docs.fereai.xyz/points): On-chain and spend rewards with weekly leaderboard.

## Help & Legal

- [FAQ](https://docs.fereai.xyz/faq): Wallet ownership, TP/SL, limit orders, credits, and points.
- [Terms of Service](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/terms): Terms of Use for the FereAI service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://docs.fereai.xyz/legal/privacy): GDPR-aligned privacy practices.
